name: Peppermint oil
short: In IBS trials adverse events were more frequent than with placebo but mild and transient; heartburn was most common. A review lists peppermint among supplements linked to bleeding risk.
text: In a meta-analysis of 10 randomised trials in irritable bowel syndrome (1030 patients), adverse events were more frequent with peppermint oil than with placebo (relative risk 1.57, 95% CI 1.04 to 2.37). An earlier meta-analysis of nine trials found that such events were mild and transient, and that the most commonly reported was heartburn. A review of supplements and bleeding listed peppermint among supplements associated with bleeding risk in people taking anticoagulants.
